A full card image with the corrected text and a white E in the lower border, from the Players Committee's Holotable image set (8 July 2018).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:OTSD-L-arleilschous-PC-Errata-2018-E-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Arleil Schous (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]] (by 25 January 2018): Same words as the disc card. The bronze disc is gone; a white italic “E” is in the black lower border.

The whole disc card image and the whole E card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
